استنشقت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْشَقْتُ (istanšaqtu) /is.tan.ʃaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اِسْتَنْشَقْتَ (istanšaqta) /is.tan.ʃaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اِسْتَنْشَقْتِ (istanšaqti) /is.tan.ʃaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْشَقَ (istanšaqa)
# اِسْتَنْشَقَتْ (istanšaqat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
